title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools and surface processing systems, with a heritage of over 200 years. Its machines lap, polish and fine-grind surfaces for manufacturers in more than 20 industries. The company has 600+ employees, 40,000+ m² of production space and revenue above €250 million.

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing segments in chips, driven by chiplet architectures, heterogeneous integration and next-generation compute. The Bengaluru software team builds the software behind this new equipment line.

**About the Role**

As a Software Engineer II in Software Engineering – Semiconductor Equipment, you'll write the software that drives high-precision semiconductor machines. You'll work where software meets hardware, building control interfaces, operator GUIs and automated system controls that meet semiconductor-industry standards. The role is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru.

**What you'll do**

* Design, develop, test and integrate software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
* Build C#/C++ DLL interfaces that let customers control the equipment programmatically.
* Build operator interfaces for the equipment in C# (WinForms/WPF) and C++.
* Implement hardware control modules over serial interfaces and TCP/IP.
* Develop and maintain automated system controls for equipment operations.
* Run system testing, debugging and performance optimisation.
* Support customers and field teams after deployment, debugging issues on live equipment.

**What you bring**

* 3–6 years of professional software development in C# / .NET.
* Hands-on C# and C++, with strong OOP, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* GUI development with C# .NET (WinForms and WPF).
* Has built software that talks to hardware (instruments, machines, PLCs or embedded devices) over serial or TCP/IP.
* Solid multithreading and concurrent programming.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis on complex systems.
* Familiarity with PLC programming concepts and industrial automation.
* Version control with GitHub or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, and clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of SEMI software standards (SECS/GEM, GEM300) and equipment cybersecurity.
* Experience in regulated or high-precision domains such as semiconductor, healthcare/medical devices or aerospace.

You will work in this stack from day one.

Web: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

Content: Strapi headless CMS (REST API) , Content Generators

Hosting and cloud: AWS Amplify, Lambda, EventBridge, S3, CloudFront

  **Next.js**

  **AWS**

  **headless CMS**

— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About Company**

Smart Bricks is the applied AI lab for real assets. It builds frontier AI systems and autonomous agents for the global real estate and AI infrastructure industries, so institutions can do in minutes what used to take months of manual work. Smart Bricks is backed by a16z Speedrun, Techstars, 500 Global, HBS Angels and others, supported by Balderton Capital, and was selected for the Palantir Startup Fellowship (Cohort 003). It works with institutional investors, fund managers and family offices across the UK, Middle East and US.

**Job Roles & Responsibilities**

* Build agentic systems: multi-step agents, tool use and workflows for sourcing, underwriting, due diligence, IC memos and portfolio monitoring
* Own the AI stack: RAG and document pipelines, model routing across frontier and open models, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs into Excel and IC formats
* Build evals and observability for accuracy, cost, latency and reliability so every number traces back to source
* Build reusable connectors, data pipelines and components that make each new deployment faster
* Embed with clients (real estate PE funds, institutional investors, family offices) to learn their data, workflows and decisions
* Partner with GTM on discovery and scoping calls, turn messy client problems into a technical plan, and help close and expand accounts
* Prototype within days, iterate on client feedback and take solutions to production; own the technical relationship through rollout
* Turn one-off client builds into platform features

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3+ years shipping production software, ideally in Python and/or TypeScript
* Deep hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: agents, RAG, tool use, evals and context engineering (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP or similar)
* Strong grasp of the AI model landscape and accuracy/cost/speed trade-offs; solid ML fundamentals, including knowing when not to use an LLM
* A builder's track record: founding engineer, early startup hire, ex-founder/CTO, or a top engineering team where you owned outcomes end to end
* Comfortable in front of clients and able to explain technical trade-offs to a fund partner
* Cloud fundamentals (AWS, GCP or Azure), data pipelines, and awareness of enterprise security (data isolation, access controls)
* Comfortable working across UK and GCC hours; available to join immediately
* Strong plus: finance, real estate, private markets or consulting exposure; forward-deployed or solutions engineering experience; document-heavy AI (PDFs, spreadsheets, data rooms); quantitative degree
